description: Lists the bookable room packages for one hotel. Required: `hotelId` (from `get_search_results`), the SAME `searchKey` from `hotel_search`, plus `startDate`, `endDate`, `rooms[]`, `nationality`, and `regionId` (re-supply the same values used in `hotel_search`); `currency` is recommended. Returns `packages[]`, each with a `quoteId` (the priced, bookable offer — format `packageId_hotelId`), a `packageId` (the same string as the `quoteId`; truncate it at the underscore before sending it to `check_cancellation_policy`), `roomName`, `mealType`, `price`, `pricePerNight`, `totalNights`, `amenities`, and `isRefundable`. No authentication required. Pass a chosen `quoteId` to `prepare_booking` (and to `confirm_booking` for B2B). To inspect cancellation terms first, pass `quoteId.split('_')[0]` (the bare package UUID, WITHOUT the `_hotelId` suffix) to `check_cancellation_policy` — handing it the full `quoteId` fails with a misleading SESSION_EXPIRED even on a live session.
name: get_hotel_rooms
title: Get Hotel Rooms
